name: Fabric Capacity
author: edward
description: Pause/resume one or more Azure Microsoft Fabric capacities from the bar. The icon reflects combined live state (active/paused/transitioning) and flags an expired az login.

barWidget.description: Left-click to see every configured capacity's state, resize it, and pause/resume it. Right-click to add/remove capacities by resource ID. Uses the az CLI's cached login; flags and offers to fix an expired login.
